'''Turtle soup,''' also known as '''terrapin soup,''' is a [[soup]] or [[stew]] made from the meat of [[turtle]]s. Several versions of the soup exist in different cultures, and it is often viewed as a [[delicacy]].<ref>{{cite book | last1=Collin | first1=R. | last2=Collin | first2=R.H. | title=New Orleans Cookbook | publisher=Alfred A.
